verdictSub.HOLD: Do not administer until the checks below are done

reasons.vvm_discard: The VVM has reached the discard point (stage 3 or 4).
reasons.shake_test_failed: The shake test shows the vaccine was damaged by freezing.
reasons.shake_test_required: This freeze-sensitive vaccine was exposed to 0 °C or below. Do a shake test before use.
reasons.vvm_not_checked: The VVM was not checked. Read the VVM on the vial before use; if the vial has no VVM, contact your supervisor.

warnings.vvm_use_first: VVM stage 2: use this vial before vials at stage 1.
warnings.heat_estimate_low: The calculated heat exposure is high. Report this cold chain break to your supervisor.

actions.USABLE: Administer following standard protocol. Record the cold chain break.
actions.HOLD: Keep the vial in the cold chain at its recommended temperature, label it "Do not use", and complete the checks above.
actions.DISCARD: Discard the vial. Record the disposal and report it to your supervisor.

result.estimateNote: Reference only. Based on unverified model parameters; it does not decide whether the vaccine can be used.

flowSteps: Select a vaccine from the WHO EPI presets, or enter custom Arrhenius parameters (Ea, k_ref, reference temperature).
Enter each temperature exposure interval — temperature (°C) and duration (hours).
View the result: calculated Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT), remaining potency, and VVM-equivalent risk level.
Review past assessments in History — stored on this device only.
help.safetyTitle: The physical VVM label always takes priority
help.safetyDesc: VaxGuard's result is a calculated estimate for planning and training purposes. If the vial has a physical Vaccine Vial Monitor (VVM) label, its actual reading always overrides this app's calculation. If the two disagree, VaxGuard will flag a mismatch warning — follow the physical VVM in that case.

termList.desc: A single equivalent constant temperature that represents a series of variable temperature exposures, per WHO TRS 961 Annex 9.
A heat-sensitive label on the vaccine vial. Stage 1 = usable, through Stage 4 = discard.
How sensitive a vaccine's degradation rate is to temperature (kJ/mol), used in the Arrhenius equation.
The degradation rate constant at a defined reference temperature.
A vaccine included in WHO's Expanded Programme on Immunization.
Shown on vaccines that must never be frozen.

help.customDesc: Only enter Ea, k_ref, and reference temperature values from a reliable source — the manufacturer's data sheet or WHO documentation. Do not guess these numbers; an incorrect value can produce a misleading result.
help.dataDesc: Assessment history is stored only in this browser's local storage on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
